s: Look at the picture. A boy in shorts is sleeping 　　　. 【109年會考補考】
e: 根據附圖，穿短褲的男孩「在河邊」睡覺，故答案選(Ａ)。

s: Don’t forget that Mom and Dad won’t be home until next Wednesday.  Until 　　　, we have to prepare meals ourselves. 【109年會考補考】
e: 雙親要到下星期三才回來，直到「那時」都得自己準備餐點，故答案選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)遲的(Ｂ)現在(Ｄ)今天。

s: Dylan looks a lot younger than his 　　　.  Though he’s already 30 now, many think he’s still in high school when they first meet him. 【109年會考補考】
e: Dylan　的外表看起來比他的「年紀」年輕得多，故答案選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)時間(Ｂ)意志(Ｃ)臉。

s: Although it’s been ten years, it still hurts Ronald to talk about how he 　　　 the chance to take a picture with his favorite baseball player. 【109年會考補考】
e: 「錯過」和最喜愛的棒球選手合照的機會，故答案選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)不及格(Ｃ)結束(Ｄ)打破。

s: Fire fighters need to wear 　　　 before going into a burning house, so smoke won’t get into their nose and throat. 【109年會考補考】
e: 由後句的　smoke（煙），推知消防隊員進火場前需戴「口罩」以阻隔煙霧，故答案選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)腰帶(Ｂ)手套(Ｃ)夾克。

s: Southwell Tennis Club was the 　　　 club that David joined last year.  He was too busy to join any other club. 【109年會考補考】
e: 網球社是　David　去年「唯一」參加的社團。他忙到沒有空參加別的社團，故答案選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)最好的(Ｂ)第一的(Ｄ)其他的。

s: Do you like goat milk?  I just got 　　　 from the market. 【109年會考補考】
e: 以　some　代替不可數名詞　milk，故答案選(Ｂ)。(Ａ)　them　為複數代名詞；(Ｃ)　any　用於否定句；(Ｄ)　another（另一）其後接單數名詞。

s: I knew that George could play the flute, 　　　 I didn’t know he was so good at it.  I’m really surprised. 【109年會考補考】
e: 知道　George　會吹長笛，「但是」不知道他這麼厲害。語氣有所轉折，故答案選(Ｂ)。

s: Amy: How’s the weather there in Japan?  Is it snowing?  Sandy: No, but 　　　 for the next few days.  I learned it from the TV news. 【109年會考補考】
e: 由　the next few days　推知是未來幾天會下雨，故答案選(Ｄ)。

s: Henry: Shelly’s in the nurse’s office, 　　　 she?  Daniel: Yeah, she just cut her finger. 【109年會考補考】
e: Shelly’s＝Shelly is，故答案選(Ｂ)。(Ａ)主詞和　was　不能縮寫；(Ｃ)人名可和　has　縮寫，但句子裡並無過去分詞，所以(Ｃ)不恰當；(Ｄ)句子中沒有一般動詞，故不能用助動詞　didn’t　來造附加問句。

s: Dad: Where are you, Mary?  Come out!  Mom: You know, 　　　 with you.  She won’t come out until you find her. 【109年會考補考】
e: 由　She won’t come out until you find her.　推知　Mary　現在正在玩躲貓貓，故答案選(Ｂ)。

s: The weather is always changing, so I don’t know 　　　 I should bring an umbrella when I go out. 【109年會考補考】
e: 天氣一直在變化，不知道「是否」該帶傘出門。(Ａ)如何(Ｂ)什麼(Ｃ)哪裡。

s: Writing stories 　　　 what my father liked to do best in his younger days. 【109年會考補考】
e: 動名詞當主詞視為單數，由　my father liked... in his younger days　得知是過去的事情，故答案選(Ｂ)。

s: Nancy does not like to spend time taking out the garbage.  She always has her brother 　　　 it for her. 【109年會考補考】
e: 本句中　has　為使役動詞，其後接原形動詞作為補語，故答案選(Ａ)。

s: Can anyone who knows the answer 　　　 it out loud? 【109年會考補考】

s: (１)　What does Alex tell people about Purple Star?
p: 【109年會考補考】

They would enjoy it more if they read it a second time.
They must read Heaton’s other books before they read this one.
They would not find any other books that are as good as this one.
e: 第三段　Alex　認為作者頻頻變動敘事者（“I　”），讓讀者無所適從，及第四段　joy wouldn’t be one of them.　推知　Alex　認為讀這本書不是愉快的經驗，故答案選(Ａ)。

s: (２)　What does Alex mean when he says Lyle Heaton goes too far this time?
p: 【109年會考補考】
o: There are too many fights in Purple Star.
Heaton keeps changing who the “I　” is in Purple Star.
The bad guys win everything at the end of Purple Star.
The good people in Purple Star never do anything wrong.
e: 由　goes too far this time　後面的句子，可得知　Alex　認為作者擅長描寫反派，但這本書「反派大獲全勝」的結局太過火了，故答案選(Ｃ)。

He seldom watches movies that are made from books.
He thinks a story without bad guys in it is not like real life.
He has decided to watch the movie made about Purple Star.
e: 由第二段第二、三行可知　Alex　認為真實人生中不會只有不做錯事的好人，故答案選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)文章未提及；(Ｂ)(Ｄ)文章只提到　Purple Star　一書不能打動　Alex，所以他不會去看此書改編的電影。

Why bees have become fewer than before.
How much the number of bees has dropped in the UK.

There could be a 54% drop in our food without their help.
They need to fight the Varroa Destructor to get enough food.
The lives of bees may be harder because of people’s need for land.

p:
The Chinese say, “If you’re bitten by a snake once, you’ll be scared by a rope for ten years.” I have my own experience of this.
　　It one night. I was cooking dinner, and at that moment, I really needed to go to the bathroom. Without turning the gas off, I quickly went to the bathroom. When I finished, I couldn’t open the door. “I can’t get out!” I shouted. I became worried that I in a fire!
　　“No!” I kicked the door hard but it didn’t move an inch. I turned around and saw hope. I hurried over to the window and pushed it really hard. . I just couldn’t open it. I would have to break it. I started hitting it with the hardest thing I could find　—　a trash can.
　　With a loud “BANG,” the window broke. “I’m safe!” I took in the fresh air happily. , the cold wind woke me from my joy. I was on the tenth floor and there was no way to get down! I kept shouting for help. Luckily, someone heard me and called 119.
　　Since then, I’ve never closed the door when I use my bathroom.

【109年會考補考】
e: 描述過去某天晚上（one night）發生的事，用過去簡單式，故答案選(Ｄ)。
